Welcome to my website!

I am an **assistant professor in economics** at Université Paris Nanterre and a member
of [EconomiX](https://economix.fr/) (UMR 7235, CNRS).

My research lies in **environmental and energy economics**. I study the economics of the
energy transition in the **automobile sector** — electric vehicles, car purchase
incentives and second-hand markets — as well as **climate policy design** and the local
impacts of **renewable energy** deployment.
